reviews.text: You should definitely avoid bringing a rabbit. They advertise that they do, but in reality, they hardly ever do. Despite having a hotel service, they don't provide any food, and I wasn't satisfied with their service, as they didn't offer any explanation.

The doctor was very kind! They had the latest equipment, and it seemed like cancer treatment was progressing well. My usual place was closed, so I always rely on this place. I have a heart condition and my heart was blocked with struvite crystals, so I went here this time. It was very reassuring.
They always provide thorough explanations and treatment. It's a good hospital.
